dog.description_text:
Gouda is a 4-year-old terrier mix who weighs around 19 lbs and is a gentle, affectionate little guy. He’s house-trained, crate-trained, and already a pretty great walking buddy. He barely pulls on leash and is easy to redirect when he gets a little excited.

He was noted to do well with other dogs at the shelter, and now that he’s in the city, he’s taking a more thoughtful approach to meeting new pups. He likes to make sure his space is respected, so slow introductions are the best way to help him feel comfortable and set him up for success.

Gouda is sweet, easy to handle, and very happy to be close to his people. He’s the kind of dog who makes it very easy to want him around.

Registered adopters interested in Gouda can email adopt@hbrdogs.com for more info. If you're not registered yet, do it today at hbrdogs.com!
